TKUI.About:
What this module imports. Only openly licensed content: the D&D System Reference Document 5.1 and 5.2 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0), OGL 1.0a open game content, and CC0 / public domain material.

Where the SRD comes from. The SRD documents are copied from the compendiums of the dnd5e game system you already have installed, which carries the SRD under CC-BY-4.0. This module bundles no rules text of its own.

What it will not do. It never scrapes or connects to D&D Beyond, and it refuses content tagged with non-SRD Wizards of the Coast books (Monster Manual, Player's Handbook, Xanathar's, …).

Attribution. Each import records its licence and attribution notice on every entry (Source → Licence) and in the Imported Content Attribution journal. Keep those notices if you share your world or compendiums.

S.dupHint: Update: refresh entries whose source changed, but keep any you edited. Skip: never touch existing entries. Overwrite: always replace with the source version.
